method: Top 60 explicit 'a series of X' clusters exported by `node scripts/build-manager-map.cjs --export-review --top 60`. Each cluster was read on its vehicle names and classified by hand. Approve only when the filings identify one manager: the vehicles repeat the manager's own name or code and no unrelated third-party brand appears. Reject SPV platforms, filing administrators, generic master-series entities, and clusters whose vehicle names carry no manager identity (the Exitfund failure mode) — those need Form ADV/CRD evidence, not a name merge.
